annotations.title: Show something on the call page

description: Put a card on the person's call page (never spoken): text, code, a link or an image. kind: text (default), code (monospace with copy button), link (exactly one http(s) URL, shown as a tappable link), image (`image` = SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP). A new card appears as a small preview top left; panel cards opens the large view, board, log or decisions open those panels, none closes them. Limits: text 4000 chars, title 80, SVG 100 KB, raster 1024 KB.

image.description: kind image: SVG text or base64 PNG/JPEG/WebP (SVG max 100 KB, raster max 1 MB).
image.title: Image

text.description: Card text, max 4000 chars (code: the code; link: the URL).
text.title: Text
